description: This Java class, RootController, is a Spring MVC controller that handles HTTP GET requests to the application root ('/'). Its primary function is to redirect incoming requests from the root URL to the '/docs' endpoint, which typically hosts API documentation (Swagger UI). The class utilizes annotations for API documentation and web request handling, and employs Spring's RedirectView for performing the redirection while preserving the scheme, host, and port information from the original request.

classes.name: RootController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller that handles root URL requests and redirects to API documentation.

methods.name: root
methods.description: Handles GET requests to '/' and redirects to '/docs', constructing the redirect URL based on the incoming request.
